becomes a left-aligned identity — a 48px `titleLeading` visual (Avatar / ChatAvatarGroup), gap 12, the title in

props.name: onTitleClick

props.name: trailingGroup

props.name: title

props.name: largeTitle
props.description: Figma Expand-Heading (Heading/1–3) under the navigator bar.

props.name: leading

props.name: trailing

props.name: largeTitleAction

props.name: controlBar

props.name: searchAction

props.description:
For a Search control bar: while `collapsed`, the bar folds away and this Search action appears at the start of the
trailing slot (top-right); it leaves again when the bar expands. Its `onClick` usually scrolls back up and focuses
the field. Counts toward the two trailing actions, so keep at most one other. `label` defaults to the locale's
“Search”, `icon` to icon-search-medium-line (an icon name or an element).

props.name: collapsed

props.name: sticky

props.name: showLabels

props.name: action

props.name: fixed
props.description: Pin to the bottom of the viewport / scroll container.

props.name: backdrop
props.description: Floating types: what sits behind the pill. `surface` (Figma) fades transparent → Surface/Default for plain screens; `none` keeps only the progressive blur, for photos and video where a Surface band would show as a white strip.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark. Default: the locale's “Main”.

props.name: search

props.name: items

props.name: selectedId

props.name: children

props.type: { label: ReactNode; onClick?: () => void; level?: ButtonLevel; disabled?: boolean; autoFocus?: boolean }

props.name: actionsDirection

props.name: dismissible

props.name: inline
props.description: Render inside the nearest positioned ancestor instead of the viewport (device previews, embedded demos).

props.name: closeLabel

props.name: author
props.description: Others: who sent it (the avatar and, when `showName`, the name above the bubble).

props.name: showName
props.description: Show the author's name above the bubble (Figma Name; group chats).

props.name: continued
props.description: Hide the avatar but keep its space (follow-up messages in a run).

props.name: time
props.description: Business: inside the bubble (Caption/Regular). Social: under the bubble.

props.name: status
props.description: Figma Sent: a status line under your last message ("Sent", "Seen").

props.name: failed
props.description: Your message could not be sent: a Negative "Not delivered" line with a Retry action replaces the status.

props.name: seenBy
props.description: Figma Chat/Section/Read-List: people who have seen the message.

props.name: children
props.description: Figma Bubble-*-Content: plain text is wrapped in a text bubble; pass ChatFile / ChatCall / ChatPhotos as-is.

props.name: id
props.description: Message id (→ data-message-id): lets a reply's quote jump back to this message.

props.name: replyTo
props.description: This message replies to another: a quote of the original sits above the bubble (ChatReplyQuote).

props.name: onJumpToReply
props.description:
Pressing the quote; defaults to scrolling to `[data-message-id]` in the same thread and flashing it. The quote of a
deleted message (`replyTo.kind` "deleted") is not pressable.

props.name: holdActions
props.description:
Hold to react (Figma Chat/Bubble/Focused/*, mobile): a long press, right-click, or Shift+F10 / the Menu key on the focused
message opens a blurred layer with the Reaction-Bar above the bubble and these actions below it (Popover/Default).
On desktop (ChatThread device="desktop") the same actions live in the Hover toolbar; right-click / Shift+F10 opens its More menu.
Use `chatHoldActions` for the Figma sets: their built-in labels show in the ZenProvider locale, your own labels as written.

props.name: reaction
props.description: Your reaction to this message (selected in the Reaction-Bar); `onReact` enables the bar.

props.name: onMoreReactions
props.description: Reaction-Bar "+": open a full emoji picker.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Figma placeholder "Aa" (the locale's `composerPlaceholder` by default).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the field (the placeholder is not a label); the locale's "Message" by default.

props.name: onEmoji
props.description: The emoji button inside the field.

props.name: actions
props.type: { icon: IconName | ReactElement; label: string; onClick?: () => void }[]
props.description: Figma Leading-Actions (plus · mic · photo; only plus while typing): Nav-Action/Icon-Flat 44px on mobile, Button/Icon-Flat Medium 40px on desktop. `icon`: an icon name or an element.

props.name: quickAction
props.type: { icon: IconName | ReactElement; label: string; onClick?: () => void }
props.description: Figma Trailing-Actions when the field is empty (a 👍 "Send a like" by default). While typing it becomes Send. `icon`: an icon name or an element.

props.name: replyTo
props.description: Replying to a message: a "Replying to …" bar above the field (× or Escape cancels). Attach it to what you send.

props.name: device
props.description: Figma Device: text caps at 220 (Mobile) / 516 (Desktop), photo grids at 260 / 400.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the thread; defaults to the locale's "Messages".

props.name: group
props.description: A group conversation shows two overlapping avatars (Figma Chat/Avatar-Group).

props.name: preview
props.description: Last message (State=Text). Ignored when `call` is set.

props.name: call
props.description: Last activity was a call (State=Audio Missed Call · Video Missed Call · Audio In/Out-Call · Ongoing-Call).

props.name: callLabel
props.description: Override the call label (the locale's "Missed Call", "Audio Call", "Ongoing Call…").

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the panel (the locale's "Choose a reaction" by default).

props.name: mine
props.description: Your reaction (ChatMessage `reaction`): listed first as "You".

props.name: onRemoveMine
props.description: Pressing the "You" row removes your reaction (ChatMessage passes `onReact(undefined)`).

props.name: anchorRef
props.description: The pill: anchors the desktop Popover and finds the device frame's overlay root on mobile.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: The action's text (the locale's Call back / Call Again / Send Voice by default).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the bar; defaults to the locale's "React".

props.name: onMore
props.description: Figma Reaction-Bar "+": replace the built-in emoji panel with your own full picker.

props.name: size
props.description: Short (sm, md…) or Figma (small, medium…) spelling.

props.name: actions
props.description: Figma Items slot: actions shown on hover / focus (You: copy · edit; AI: like · dislike · regenerate · copy).

props.name: version
props.description: AI: which answer version is shown ("1/2"), next to the actions.

props.name: streaming
props.description: AI: the reply is still streaming (a pulsing caret follows the text).

props.name: thinking
props.description: AI: the assistant is working and no text has arrived yet — three dots in a looping wave. Also shown when `streaming` has no content yet.

props.name: thinkingLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the thinking indicator (the locale's "Thinking" by default).

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Prompt placeholder, also the field's accessible name (the locale's "Ask me anything" by default).

props.name: model
props.description: Figma Model: the model switch label (Body/Base/Medium + chevron) — open your model Popover from `onModelClick`.

props.name: onAttach
props.description: Figma Leading-Actions (+): attachments or tools.

props.name: onVoice
props.description: Figma trailing microphone (Icon-Flat).

props.name: busy
props.description: While the reply streams, the primary button becomes Stop.

props.name: greeting
props.description: Say-Hi heading (the locale's "How can I help you today?" by default).

props.name: logo
props.description: Say-Hi logo: an icon name or your own node (the Zen mark by default).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the conversation (the locale's "Conversation" by default).

props.name: title
props.description: Figma Header Label (Heading/Subheading).

props.name: headingLevel
props.description:
Heading level of the title in the page outline (default 3: a card inside an h2 section). Use 2 when the card sits
 directly under the page title. The look stays Heading/Subheading — the level follows the outline, not the size.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Figma Header trailing Button/Icon-Main XSmall Tertiary (chevron): opens the full report.

props.name: openLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the open button. Default: the locale's “Open report”.

props.name: ranges
props.description: Figma Segmented (Secondary) range switch.

props.name: format
props.description: Figma `icon-media-file` Format.

props.name: size
props.description: Same scale as Icon (Element-Size/Popular); Figma draws it at 20 (base).

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible name; without it the icon is decorative (the file name usually sits next to it).

props.name: theme
props.description: Colour mode. `system` follows the OS (prefers-color-scheme). Unset: inherit (the page default is light).

props.name: componentTheme
props.description: Component colour theme (Figma "Component Theme" mode). Default neutral-s1.

props.name: density
props.description: Spacing density. Default compact (dashboards); comfortable for touch-first or marketing layouts.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner-radius scale. Default rounded.

props.name: emphasis
props.description: Font weights and active stroke widths (Figma "Emphasis Level" mode). Default medium; light is lighter, strong heavier.

props.name: breakpoint
props.description:
Layout tokens (page margin, gutter, modal/card padding). `auto` follows the viewport: < 744px mobile,
< 1024px tablet, else desktop. Default: `auto` on the outermost provider, inherited in nested ones.

props.name: typography
props.description: Text-style scale. dashboard (default) for web apps, mobile for phone apps, popular for marketing pages.

props.name: locale
props.description:
BCP 47 language of the content: sets `lang`, date formats, and the built-in labels of every Zen component
(accessible names, "Close", "Next page", toolbar tooltips…). Built in: en, vi. Unknown languages fall back to en.

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<Omit<ZenLabels, "richText" | "holdActions" | "opinion">> & { richText?: Partial<ZenLabels["richText"]>; holdActions?: Partial<ZenLabels["holdActions"]>; opinion?: Partial<ZenLabels["opinion"]>; }
props.description: Override single built-in labels, or supply every label for another language: `labels={{ close: "Schließen" }}`.

props.name: paint
props.description: Paint the Canvas background, the primary text colour and the Zen font on this element. Default true.

props.name: syncDocument
props.description:
Also write the modes onto <html>, so the page background (reset.css) and anything portalled to <body> follow
them. Default: true for the outermost provider that paints, false otherwise.

props.name: portal
props.description: Render a portal root inside this provider so overlays (Dialog, Toast, Tooltip, Menu…) inherit its modes. Default true.

props.name: toastPlacement
props.description:
Where toasts from useToast() appear (the outermost provider hosts them; nested providers share it).
Default bottom-center.

props.name: direction
props.description: column (default) stacks top to bottom; row lays items side by side.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between items (Figma Spacing/Gap). Default md (16px).

props.name: align
justify
props.description: Main-axis distribution. `between` pushes the first and last items to the edges.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Let row items wrap onto new lines.

props.name: padding
props.description: Space inside the stack (Figma Spacing/Padding).

props.name: paddingX
props.description: Horizontal padding (overrides `padding` on the sides).

props.name: paddingY
props.description: Vertical padding (overrides `padding` top and bottom), e.g. page content inside a Container that already has side margins.

props.name: columns
props.type: GridTracks | { mobile?: GridTracks; tablet?: GridTracks; desktop?: GridTracks }
props.description:
Fixed column count, or per breakpoint (`{ mobile: 1, tablet: 2, desktop: 3 }`, following ZenProvider's
breakpoint). A string is a track list for unequal columns: `{ mobile: 1, desktop: "2fr 1fr" }` puts a main column
next to an aside. Omit it to fit as many `minColumnWidth` columns as the width allows.

props.name: minColumnWidth
props.description: Responsive auto-fill: every column is at least this wide (px or CSS length). Default 240.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between cells. Default md (16px).

props.name: align
props.description: Vertical alignment of cells. Default stretch (equal-height cards).

props.name: surface
props.description:
Background layer (docs/guidelines/background-layers.md): `surface` for cards and panels on the Canvas page,
`surface-alt` on a white (Alt) canvas, `subtle` / `pale` for wells. Never Canvas (the page), Flat (navigation) or
Container (modals and sheets use Dialog / BottomSheet).

props.name: border
props.description: Closed-box border: `subtle` when the box is actionable, `pale` when it is static (docs/guidelines/borders.md).

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Content width: sm 640 (forms) · md 960 (settings, reading) · lg 1280 (dashboards, default) · xl 1440 · full.

props.name: gutter
props.description: Page margin on both sides from the breakpoint tokens (24 desktop/tablet, 20 mobile). Default true.

props.name: textStyle
props.description: Figma text style, e.g. "Body/Base/Regular" (default), "Body/Small/Medium", "Caption/Regular", "Heading/4".

props.name: tone
props.description: Colour role. Default strongest (primary text).

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render. Default p (a block); use span inside a line, label for a form label.

props.name: truncate
props.description: true: one line with an ellipsis; a number: clamp to that many lines. The full text stays in the DOM.

props.name: htmlFor
props.description: For `as="label"`.

props.name: level
props.description: Document level (h1–h6): pick it from the page outline, not from the size. Default 2.

props.name: textStyle
props.description:
Visual style; defaults to the level's style (1 → Heading/1 … 4 → Heading/4, 5 → Heading/Subheading). An h1 — the
 page title — always stays Heading/1 (harness: heading/h1-is-heading-1); lower levels may take another style.

props.name: sidebar
props.description: Left navigation, usually <Sidebar>. Below 1024px it moves into a drawer opened from the header's menu button.

props.name: header
props.description: Top bar content on the left (it grows): search, breadcrumbs. On small screens the drawer's menu button comes first.

props.name: headerActions
props.description: Top bar actions on the right: notifications, help, the account menu.

props.name: footer
props.description: A sticky bar at the bottom of the main column, e.g. BottomNavigation on phones.

props.name: canvas
props.description: Page background layer: default Canvas, alt (a white page) or flat (pair it with Sidebar background="flat").

props.name: navOpen
props.description: Drawer state when controlled (small screens).

props.name: navLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation drawer and its menu button's target. Default: the locale's “Navigation”.

props.name: mainId
props.description: id of <main>, the target of the "Skip to content" link. Default: a generated unique id.

props.name: layout
props.description: Force the layout; by default it follows ZenProvider's breakpoint (tablet and mobile use the drawer).

props.name: children
props.description: The page.

props.name: title
props.description: The page title (an h1 by default: one per page).

props.name: description
props.description: One or two sentences under the title.

props.name: breadcrumbs
props.description: Above the title: <Breadcrumbs> for nested pages.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Above the title when there are no breadcrumbs: a short section label.

props.name: actions
props.description: Page actions on the right of the title: Tertiary buttons first, then at most one Primary. They wrap under the title on narrow screens; on phones (ZenProvider breakpoint mobile) the Primary is shown first.

props.name: meta
props.description: Next to the title: a status Badge, Tag or AvatarStack.

props.name: tabs
props.description: Under the header: <Tabs> that switch the page's sections.

props.name: back
props.description: A Back control for detail pages (chevron icon, per the navigation rule).

props.name: headingLevel
props.description:
Heading level of the title. Default 1 (Heading/1, the Figma Master-Layout page title); 2 (Heading/2) only when the
 page already has an h1 (e.g. inside a tab). The text style always follows the level.

props.name: href
props.description: Destination URL. Required unless `as` renders a router link that takes its own destination prop (e.g. `to`).

props.name: external
props.description:
Opens the destination in a new tab: adds `target="_blank"`, `rel="noopener noreferrer"`, a trailing external-link icon
and a visually hidden “(opens in a new tab)” (in the locale's language), so the change of context is visible and announced. Use it for other
sites (docs, status pages, help centres), not for pages of the same app.

props.name: underline
props.description:
When the underline shows: `hover` (default; also on keyboard focus) for standalone links, `always` for links inside
running text so they never rely on colour alone, `none` only where the context already says it is a link
(a navigation list). Defaults to `always` when `tone="inherit"`.

props.name: tone
props.description:
Colour: `hyperlink` (default) uses Content/Hyperlink Default, Pressed while pressed and Visited (see `visited`);
`inherit` takes the surrounding text colour (footers, captions, legal lines) and is underlined by default.

props.name: visited
props.description:
Show the Content/Hyperlink/Visited colour once the destination has been visited. Default false: in-app links keep one
colour; turn it on for content links people scan repeatedly (search results, articles, docs). `hyperlink` tone only.

props.name: as
props.description:
Element or router component rendered instead of `<a>`, e.g. `as={RouterLink} to="/settings"` (React Router,
Next.js Link). Every other prop, the ref included, is forwarded to it.

props.name: children
props.description: The link text. Name the destination (“Billing settings”), never “click here”. The font comes from the surrounding Text.

props.name: trigger
props.description:
The control that opens the menu: a Button or an IconButton with an aria-label (it names the menu too). It receives
aria-haspopup="menu", aria-expanded and aria-controls, and the opening keys (Enter · Space · ↓ first item, ↑ last item).

props.name: items
props.description: The actions: items, `{ type: "separator" }` and `{ type: "group", label, items }`. Without it, compose `children`.

props.name: children
props.description: Composable entries (`MenuItem`, `MenuSeparator`, `MenuGroup`), used when `items` is not given.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the chosen item (after the item's own `onSelect`); then the menu closes and focus returns to the trigger.

props.name: align
props.description: Which edge of the trigger the menu lines up with: `start` (default) or `end` (a trigger at the right end of a row or card). Flips when it would leave the viewport.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state; pair it with `onOpenChange`. Default: uncontrolled and closed.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial state when uncontrolled. Default false.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with `true` when the trigger opens the menu and `false` when it closes (choice, Escape, Tab, outside press).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the menu. Default: the trigger's name (aria-labelledby).

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the floating surface.

props.name: id
props.description: Stable id, handed back to the Menu's `onSelect`. Default: the label.

props.name: label
props.description: The action, verb first (“Duplicate”, “Move to…”). One line: a long label ends in “…”.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon: an icon name (drawn at 20px) or an element. Give every item of a menu an icon, or none.

props.name: caption
props.description: A second line with a short consequence (“Anyone with the link can view”).

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Keyboard shortcut shown on the right (“⌘D”). Display only: the app wires the shortcut itself.

props.name: danger
props.description: Destructive action (Delete, Remove): Content/Negative text. Put it last, after a separator.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Not available right now: dimmed and skipped by the arrow keys.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Runs when the item is chosen (click, Enter or Space); then the Menu's `onSelect` runs and the menu closes.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the row.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the line.

props.name: label
props.description: Small heading above the items (“Share”, “Move to”); it names the group for screen readers.

props.name: children
props.description: MenuItem and MenuSeparator elements.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the group.

props.name: form
props.description:
The state from `useFormState()`. Form submits through `form.handleSubmit`: it validates, shows every error, moves
focus to the first invalid field and announces how many need attention. Pass either `form` or `onSubmit`.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description:
Your own submit handler, called after `preventDefault()` (e.g. react-hook-form's `handleSubmit(onValid)`). Return a
promise and Form waits for it; then, if any field is invalid (aria-invalid), it focuses the first one and announces the count.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between the form's direct children (Figma Spacing/Gap): the groups of a form. Default lg (24px); fields inside a group use md.

props.name: invalidMessage
props.description: Screen-reader message after a failed submit. Default: the locale's "1 field needs attention" / "3 fields need attention".

props.name: noValidate
props.description: Skip the browser's own validation bubbles; Zen shows errors under each field. Default true.

props.name: children
props.description: The groups of the form, top to bottom: Stacks or Grids of fields, FormFieldsets, and FormActions last.

props.name: label
props.description: The field label (Figma Input/Label, Body/Small/Regular). Omit it only when the control carries its own label (a Checkbox).

props.name: helpText
props.description: One line of guidance under the control (Help-Text, Neutral). Replaced by `error` while there is one.

props.name: error
props.description: The error message (Help-Text, Negative). Pass `form.fieldError(name)` so it shows at the right moment.

props.name: required
props.description: Adds " *" to the label and aria-required to the control. Mark the few optional fields instead when most are required.

props.name: optional
props.description: Figma Label `Optional`: appends "(Optional)".

props.name: labelTooltip
props.description: Figma Label `Tooltip-Icon`: an info icon with this text as a tooltip.

props.name: labelAction
props.description: Figma Label `Action`: a right-aligned link or text button ("Reset to default").

props.name: controlId
props.description: id given to the control (default: generated). The label points at it.

props.name: children
props.description:
Exactly one control. It receives `id`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid` and `aria-required`,
so it must put them on its focusable element (Slider takes aria-labelledby; your own controls should take all five).

props.name: legend
props.description: Names the group ("Delivery speed", "Email me about"); read before each option. Required.

props.name: hideLegend
props.description: Hide the legend visually (screen readers still read it) when a heading right above already names the group.

props.name: kind
props.description:
What the group holds. `radio` adds role="radiogroup" (with aria-required / aria-invalid), as the RadioButton
guideline asks; `toggle` spaces rows md; `checkbox`, `radio` and `group` space them sm. Default group.

props.name: direction
props.description: Stack the options (column, default) or lay them in a wrapping row (2–3 short options).

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between options (Figma Spacing/Gap). Default sm, or md for toggles.

props.name: helpText
props.description: One line of guidance for the whole group, under the options. Replaced by `error` while there is one.

props.name: error
props.description: The group's error ("Choose a delivery speed"). Pass `form.fieldError(name)`.

props.name: required
props.description: Adds " *" to the legend (and aria-required to a radio group): at least one option must be chosen.

props.name: optional
props.description: Figma Label `Optional`: appends "(Optional)" to the legend.

props.name: children
props.description: The options: Checkbox, RadioButton (sharing one `name`) or Toggle rows.

props.name: align
props.description:
Where the buttons sit on wide layouts: `end` (default, right), `start`, or `between` (the first child alone on the
left, e.g. "Delete draft", the rest on the right). Write Tertiary (cancel) first and Primary (submit) last in every case.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Keep the bar pinned to the bottom of the scrolling area (Surface background, Pale top line, safe-area padding).

props.name: inset
props.description: Sticky only: side padding of the bar, e.g. lg on a full-bleed phone screen so the buttons line up with the fields.

props.name: children
props.description: The buttons: Tertiary (cancel) first, Primary (`type="submit"`, named for the outcome) last.

props.name: items
props.description: The rows, in reading order. Or pass DescriptionItem children (both render, items first).

props.name: layout
props.description:
inline (default): term at the start and value at the end of one line (order summaries, specs); it stacks by itself
when the list is narrower than `stackBelow`. stacked: term above value (profiles, addresses, long values).

props.name: divider
props.description: Pale rules (Border/Neutral/Pale) between rows, with Padding/Small above and below each rule. Default false.

props.name: stackBelow
props.description:
Inline layout only: below this width (px) of the list itself the rows stack (term above value). Default 280, so
lists in phone cards and sheets (about 300–350px) stay inline while narrow columns stack; 0 keeps them inline.

props.name: children
props.description: DescriptionItem rows.

props.name: term
props.description: The label (dt): Body/Small/Regular, Content/Neutral/Base.

props.name: description
props.description: The value (dd): Body/Base/Medium, Content/Neutral/Strongest.

props.name: action
props.description: An action for this row only (rendered in its own dd at the end of the row).

props.name: emphasis
props.description: The total row: Body/Base/Bold with a High rule above it. One per list.

props.name: className
props.description: On the row's div (the dt/dd group).

props.name: position
props.description:
sticky (default): stays at the bottom of the scrolling area while the content above scrolls, and settles at the end
of it. fixed: pinned to the bottom of the viewport; an invisible spacer of the bar's height keeps the end of the page
reachable. static: in the flow, e.g. the last row of a card.

props.name: direction
props.description:
vertical (default, phones and narrow panels): full-width stacked buttons, Primary on top. horizontal (desktop): the
summary at the start, buttons hug their labels at the end, Tertiary then Primary; when the bar itself is narrower
than 480px the summary takes its own row and the buttons split the next one (the Bottom-Sheet dual footer).

props.name: surface
props.description:
default: Surface/Default with a Pale (Border/Neutral/Pale) top rule. alt: Surface/Alt with the same rule. none: no
fill and no rule, for a static bar inside a container that already has one. Never a drop shadow.

props.name: primaryAction
props.description: The one main action (level primary). Rendered first (top) when vertical and last (end) when horizontal.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.description: One alternative (level tertiary), next to the primary: below it when vertical, before it when horizontal.

props.name: summary
props.description: Context for the actions: a total, a selection count or a status line. Above the buttons when vertical, at the start when horizontal.

props.name: children
props.description:
Custom actions (Buttons, in visual order: Primary first when vertical, last when horizontal). With primaryAction /
secondaryAction they sit on the side away from the Primary.

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL. While it is undefined (the URL is still being fetched) the Skeleton shows.

props.name: alt
props.description:
Required text alternative: what the picture shows, in context ("Matte black pour-over kettle, side view"). Use ""
only for a decorative picture that repeats text next to it; never a file name or "image of…".

props.name: ratio
props.description:
Frame ratio (width : height): "1:1" · "4:3" · "3:2" · "16:9" · "3:4", or a number (2.35). The frame keeps its size
while loading, so nothing jumps. Unset: the picture's own ratio (4:3 while it loads or fails).

props.name: fit
props.description: cover (default): fills the frame and crops. contain: shows the whole picture on Neutral/Pale bars (logos, documents).

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius on the Zen scale (Corner-Radius): none · 2xs · xs · sm · md (default, 12) · lg · xl · 2xl · 3xl · full.

props.name: loading
props.description: Native loading: lazy (default) waits until the picture nears the viewport; eager for the first picture on screen.

props.name: caption
props.description: A caption under the picture (Body/Small/Regular, Content/Neutral/Base); the picture becomes a figure with a figcaption.

props.name: className
props.description: On the root (figure or div).

props.name: style
props.description: On the root (figure or div).

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL. While it is undefined the Skeleton shows.

props.name: alt
props.description: Required text alternative. "" when the row already names the item (a ListItem title, a table cell label) next to it.

props.name: size
props.description:
Image-Size token: 3xs 16 · 2xs 20 · xs 24 · sm 32 · md 40 (default, a ListItem leading visual) · lg 48 · xl 56 ·
2xl 80 · 3xl 112 (compact density; comfortable scales them). Tables use sm with a caption, xs without.

props.name: shape
props.description: rounded (default: the radius steps with the size, like Avatar Square), circle, or square (no radius).

props.name: fit
props.description: cover (default) crops to the square; contain shows the whole picture (logos, app icons).

props.name: loading
props.description: Native loading: lazy (default) or eager.

props.name: className
props.description: On the root span.

props.name: style
props.description: On the root span.

props.name: as
props.description:
Element to render. Default span: inline, so it is valid inside buttons, links and table headers. Use div or p for a
block, h2–h6 for a heading that names a region only screen readers need, label (with htmlFor) for a hidden field
label, and a (with href and focusable) for a skip link.

props.name: focusable
props.description:
Shows the content while it, or a link or button inside it, has focus: a Surface pill (Body/Base/Medium, Subtle
ring) at the top-start corner of the nearest positioned ancestor, above the page. Use it for skip links. Default false.

props.name: href
props.description: With `as="a"`: the link target, e.g. "#main".

props.name: htmlFor
props.description: With `as="label"`: the id of the control it labels.

props.name: children
props.description: The text for assistive technology (and for the visible pill while a focusable one has focus).
